clock.implementation: dav_c220 GetSystemCycleImpl uses asm volatile MOV SYS_CNT on device
clock.measurement: PIPE_S counter; async engine completion requires selected synchronization. Containment is a coarse consistency check, not an internal timing accuracy ground truth.

limits: Actors are logical block + AIC/AIV + subblock; physical core ID is not collected.
Added counters, stores and synchronization perturb execution.
Native association is by ordered matching task events for this serial launch loop, not hardware counter alignment.
Within-launch actors are not independent statistical replicates. Statistics below use medians per launch.
Generic fused records have no subblock identity; no actual mixed-record rate is inferred.
